paras: Application: Honda Civic Type R (2017+) and Acura Integra Type S (2024+) Part Type: Billet aluminium coolant expansion tank kit Part Number: 20-0827

Plastic coolant tanks have a reputation for failing over time under constant, intense heat cycling. The Radium 20-0827 replaces the Civic Type R's factory plastic tank with a two-piece CNC-machined aluminium tank, anodised for longevity, that is robust enough for racing and conducts heat better than plastic.
hl: Two-Piece Billet Aluminium: CNC machined and anodised
OEM Volume: Internal volume equivalent to the OEM tank, so no coolant capacity is lost
Dual Chamber: Cross-over passages at the top and bottom
Swirl De-Aeration: Internal swirl feature helps remove air from the system
Bolt-In: Custom bracket uses existing threaded holes; adapter fittings connect to the factory lines
Race Proven: Used in race and street vehicles worldwide
ft: Radium Engineering Coolant Expansion Tank Kit for Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5
